results.question: what was the family reckoning?
results.reply:
The Family Reckoning [The Family Reckoning](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/wikis/the-family-reckoning) was a messy all-hands Wasp job.
Delivering an Imperial summons to [Ikoma Yuan](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/ikoma-yuan) at a teahouse ended with the Ikoma shugenja [Ikoma Tsai](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/ikoma-tsai) killed.
His father [Ikoma Wataemon](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/ikoma-wataemon) and brothers [Ikoma Naohira](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/ikoma-naohira) and [Ikoma Ietsugu](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/ikoma-ietsugu) declared a blood feud on the Wasp present.

results.question: what does righteous sting mean?

results.question: what does the peasantborn disadvantage do

You are the child of a peasant [Tsuruchi](https://waspbountyhunters.obsidianportal.com/characters/tsuruchi) raised to samurai.
